name: Euchre
tagline: Order it up, make trumps with your partner, and watch out for the bowers.

rulesSummary: Partners sit across. The pack is 9s to aces (24 cards).
Two teams of three, sitting alternately; the pack is 7s to aces (32 cards), the 8s and 7s lowest. Going alone, both your partners sit out. All five tricks or a euchre scores 3 (6 alone).
Five cards each from a short pack, and the next card is turned up. The side that makes trumps needs 3 of the 5 tricks.
Round one: each player in turn may order up the turned card's suit as trumps, or pass. If it's ordered up, the dealer picks the card up and discards one.
Round two, if all passed: the card is turned down and each player may name another suit or pass. If it gets back to the dealer, they're stuck and must name one.
Trumps rank: jack of trumps (right bower), the other jack of that colour (left bower, which counts as a trump), then A K Q 10 9. Other suits run A K Q J 10 9.
The player left of the dealer leads. Follow suit if you can; if not, play anything. The highest trump wins, or else the highest card of the suit led.
Go alone: your partner sits out (the dealer doesn't pick up if it's them), and the player on your left leads. If defenders may go alone (a lobby option), a lone defender leads.
Makers with 3 or 4 tricks score 1, with all 5 score 2 (4 alone). Makers who fall short are euchred: the other side scores 2 (4 for a lone defender). First to the target (10 unless changed) wins.
